# FOG MARCH application (PRD_FOG_MARCH 15.1): the baseline demo pages stay in
# the repository for host tests and reference, but only the game is compiled.
# Sprites are generated by tools/gen_fog_march_assets.py (PRD 10.7).
# MAFA CHRONICLE (PRD_MAFA_CHRONICLE): the active application; the fog entry
# point is switched off in main.c but its code remains compiled for reference.
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "main.c"
         "mafa_model.c"
         "mafa_view.c"
         "mafa_app.c"
         "fog_model.c"
         "fog_ai.c"
         "fog_view.c"
         "fog_app.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES bsp esp_timer nvs_flash
    EMBED_FILES "assets/fog_terrain_plain.rgb565"
                "assets/fog_terrain_plain_dim.rgb565"
                "assets/fog_terrain_mountain.rgb565"
                "assets/fog_terrain_mountain_dim.rgb565"
                "assets/fog_terrain_forest.rgb565"
                "assets/fog_terrain_forest_dim.rgb565"
                "assets/fog_terrain_river.rgb565"
                "assets/fog_terrain_river_dim.rgb565"
                "assets/fog_terrain_city.rgb565"
                "assets/fog_terrain_city_dim.rgb565"
                "assets/fog_unit_spear_blue.rgb565a8"
                "assets/fog_unit_archer_blue.rgb565a8"
                "assets/fog_unit_cavalry_blue.rgb565a8"
                "assets/fog_unit_general_blue.rgb565a8"
                "assets/fog_unit_spear_red.rgb565a8"
                "assets/fog_unit_archer_red.rgb565a8"
                "assets/fog_unit_cavalry_red.rgb565a8"
                "assets/fog_unit_general_red.rgb565a8"
)

# Application-owned CJK subset fonts (PRD 10.4 Plan B pattern). Generated by
# tools/gen_fog_march_fonts.sh / tools/gen_mafa_fonts.sh; do not compile them
# anywhere else.
target_sources(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/mafa_font_16.c"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/mafa_font_20.c"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/fog_font_16.c"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/fog_font_20.c"
)
